rationale: Primary and independent Plan 052 reviews agree on insufficient_evidence. Primary: The fare-free bus pilot has an exact actual onset in companion evidence, but combined route surfaces such as Bx18A/B and S46/S96 cannot be converted into exhaustive exact GTFS-route incidence without unsupported splitting. Independent: The candidate evidence gives only an installed-by upper bound and combines bus and paratransit pilots; it does not establish exact bus route-treatment incidence.
